name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
summary: A curl with a neutral (thumbs-up) grip that works the biceps and especially the brachialis and brachioradialis, which add thickness to the upper arm and forearm.
setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing your thighs.
Keep elbows beside your ribs and shoulders relaxed.
Brace your abs and keep the wrists straight.
execution: Curl one or both dumbbells up, keeping the palms facing each other the whole way.
Stop when the forearms are close to vertical and squeeze briefly.
Lower the weights slowly to full arm extension.
Alternate arms or curl both together, keeping the torso still.
mistakes: Swinging the weights with the hips: use lighter dumbbells and brace the core.
Letting the elbows drift forward: keep the upper arms vertical.
Rotating the palms up during the rep: that turns it into a regular curl, so keep the neutral grip.
Bending the wrists: hold the dumbbell in line with the forearm.
